description_full:
SAIL INTERSHIP BATCH 12

Still looking for an internship to kick-start your career? This might be the opportunity you've been waiting for! 👀

𝗦𝗔𝗜𝗟 𝗕𝗮𝘁𝗰𝗵 𝟭𝟮 is officially open for registration! 🚀

Join the 𝗦𝘆𝗻𝗲𝗿𝗴𝗶𝘇𝗲𝗱 𝗔𝗾𝘂𝗮𝗰𝘂𝗹𝘁𝘂𝗿𝗲 𝗜𝗻𝗻𝗼𝘃𝗮𝘁𝗶𝘃𝗲 𝗟𝗲𝗮𝗿𝗻𝗶𝗻𝗴 (SAIL) program and get the chance to gain hands on experience, develop your skills, and explore career opportunities in the aquaculture industry with PT Suri Tani Pemuka.

So, what are you waiting for? Your next learning experience could start here!

Let's SAIL with us! 🛳✨
